## Which loop / force does it touch?

- [ ] Signal → Artifact
- [ ] Room → Network
- [ ] Relationship → Contribution
- [ ] Learning → Evolution
- [ ] Substrate (schemas, core, CLI, docs) — no single loop

## Sovereignty checklist

- [ ] No agent path sends, posts, or impersonates without explicit human approval.
- [ ] No new field infers attraction, diagnosis, hidden intent, or ranks people.
- [ ] New records default to `private_context` / `proposed` / `publishable: false`.
- [ ] No private data, secrets, or personal relationship context in the diff.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm run verify` passes (schemas, tests, typecheck, lint, build).
- [ ] New behavior has a test.
- [ ] Docs/schemas updated if the wire format changed.
